meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what: 这个技能会让某个智能体组改用你电脑上的本地 Ollama 模型,不再调用 Anthropic 在线接口。它自动修改容器和模型配置,该组的消息会发到本地模型处理。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体组跑在本地、节省 API 费用,或试用开放权重模型,或直接要求把某组切到 Ollama 时触发。

say.text: 把 mygroup 切到本地 Ollama,用 gemma4:latest
say.note: 确认后会改配置并重启服务。

say.text: 把 mygroup 恢复成 Anthropic API
say.note: 移除相关配置并重启服务。

howto.what_en: Routes a chosen NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model: it rewrites container env vars and shared settings so the group's requests go to local Ollama instead of the Anthropic API, and blocks api.anthropic.com inside the container.
howto.when_en: Use when the user wants to run an agent group locally, cut API costs, experiment with open-weight models, or asks to route a group to Ollama.

say_en.text: Switch mygroup to local Ollama using gemma4:latest
say_en.note: Writes env config and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Use qwen3-coder for mygroup and block the Anthropic API
Revert mygroup back to the Anthropic API
